stem: A client is prescribed capecitabine using a dose expressed in mg/m². Which client measurement is required to determine the labeled dose?
rationale: Capecitabine prescribing information calculates the dose according to body surface area and provides dose tables based on BSA for the prescribed mg/m² regimen.
educational_objective: Use body surface area to translate an mg/m² capecitabine regimen into the labeled patient dose.
source_organization: DailyMed / U.S. National Library of Medicine
source_locator: Section 2.2 and Table 1: dose calculated according to body surface area
source_claim_supported: Capecitabine doses expressed in mg/m² are calculated using the client's body surface area.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Reduction of Risk Potential, printed p.13/PDF p.17
blueprint_topic: Reduction of Risk Potential — dosage calculation and antineoplastic safety
correction_summary: Replaced an FDA dose-optimization source that did not directly support BSA calculation with the capecitabine label's explicit BSA dosing instructions.
